intro: ゆえ is the written word for reason or cause. ゆえに states that one fact is the cause or logical ground of another, in a formal, bookish voice: 若さゆえの過ち (a mistake born of youth). At the start of a sentence it is therefore, the word of proofs and arguments. It carries no emotion and no emphasis; it just names the cause.

skills.rule: To say because of X in formal writing, put ゆえ(に) after a noun, or がゆえに after a verb or adjective; ゆえの before a noun.
skills.explain:
ゆえに is a literary から / ので. Its forms depend on what comes before. Nouns take ゆえ(に) directly or のゆえに: 若さゆえに, 貧しさのゆえに. Verbs and い-adjectives take がゆえに: 子を思うがゆえに, 雪が多いがゆえに. な-adjectives and nouns used as predicates take であるがゆえに: 正直であるがゆえに. To modify a noun use ゆえの: 若さゆえの過ち. At the head of a sentence, ゆえに alone means therefore and links premise to conclusion.

The register is the main rule. ゆえに belongs to essays, speeches, legal and academic prose, and dramatic narration. In everyday speech it sounds stiff or theatrical; use から or ので there.

The edge: ばこそ and からこそ stress that this very reason, and no other, drives the result; ゆえに just states the cause. とあって reports a reaction to a special situation (連休とあって混んでいる). こととて is an old-fashioned apologetic excuse (慣れぬこととて).
patterns: [noun / な-adj.] であるがゆえに、[result]

examples.jp: 若[わか]さ{ゆえに}、失敗[しっぱい]も多[おお]かった。
examples.en: Because I was young, I made a lot of mistakes.

examples.jp: それは若[わか]さ{ゆえ}の過[あやま]ちだった。
examples.en: It was a mistake born of youth.

examples.jp: 子[こ]を思[おも]う{がゆえに}、親[おや]は厳[きび]しくなる。
examples.en: It is out of love for their children that parents become strict.

examples.jp: 彼[かれ]は正直[しょうじき]である{がゆえに}、損[そん]をすることも多[おお]い。
examples.en: Because he is honest, he often loses out.

examples.jp: 雪[ゆき]が多[おお]い{がゆえに}、この地方[ちほう]の家[いえ]は屋根[やね]が急[きゅう]だ。
examples.en: Because of the heavy snow, houses in this region have steep roofs.

examples.jp: 人間[にんげん]は皆[みな]死[し]ぬ。彼[かれ]は人間[にんげん]だ。{ゆえに}彼[かれ]も死[し]ぬ。
examples.en: All humans die. He is human. Therefore he too will die.

contrast.note: ばこそ (and からこそ) put the spotlight on the reason: precisely because, often a motive behind a surprising act. ゆえに names the cause without that emphasis.
とあって follows a special circumstance and reports the visible result (人気の店とあって、行列ができている). ゆえに is a general cause-effect link, including logic and inner motives.
こととて is a fixed, old-fashioned way to excuse yourself or ask for pardon (不慣れなこととて、失礼しました). ゆえに is not apologetic.

mistakes.bad: 時間[じかん]がない{ゆえに}、早[はや]く来[き]てね。
mistakes.good: 時間[じかん]がない{から}、早[はや]く来[き]てね。
mistakes.note: ゆえに is formal written Japanese. In a casual request it clashes; use から.

mistakes.bad: 貧[まず]しさ{がゆえに}、学校[がっこう]に行[い]けない子供[こども]もいる。
mistakes.good: 貧[まず]しさ{ゆえに}、学校[がっこう]に行[い]けない子供[こども]もいる。
mistakes.note: A noun takes ゆえに or のゆえに directly. がゆえに follows verbs and adjectives.

mistakes.bad: 正直[しょうじき]{がゆえに}、損[そん]をする。
mistakes.good: 正直[しょうじき]である{がゆえに}、損[そん]をする。
mistakes.note: A な-adjective needs である before がゆえに.

skills.tip: Would because of or therefore sound right in a formal essay? Then ゆえに; noun + ゆえに, verb + がゆえに.
